title: Expose sale-level market verification progress
guarantees: Market evidence UI shows supporting realized sales, original-verified sales, pending original sales and sale verification share.
Sale verification progress uses the same fail-closed original-evidence rules as the step-719 verification contract.
Verification progress is derived from lazily loaded market records for the active product, format and team context.
Reset and load-error states clear or withhold sale-level verification progress rather than displaying stale values.
